headline: Demolition delay waiver for 56 Margin Street; exterior work requests at several Salem addresses; FY27 Community Preservation Act Plan comment.
summary: The agenda lists a waiver of the Demolition Delay for 56 Margin Street and several Certificate of Appropriateness requests. It also asks for comment on the FY27 Community Preservation Act Plan.
items: 141 Federal Street (Steven Gregory and Mary Bratun): replace wood gutters. Reviewed as a minor change; certificate to be issued October 16, 2026 if no abutter objection is received.
183R Federal Street (Alina McCurdy): architectural roof shingles. Reviewed as a minor change; certificate to be issued October 16, 2026 if no abutter objection is received.
1A Cambridge Street (Eleanor Uddo): install solar. Continued.
169 Federal Street (Alicia and Brian Peters): fencing. Continued.
44 Derby Street (Adam Liebowitz and Kate Lerner): install heat pump and exterior conduits after the fact. Continued.
107 Federal Street (Susan Hacker): A/C condenser and exterior electrical work after the fact. Continued.

56 Margin Street, including 54 Margin Street, 7 High Street, 20 Endicott Street, and 24 Endicott Street (Harborlight Homes and Lifebridge): waiver of the Demolition Delay to demolish 2 buildings older than 50 years and partially demolish 1 building older than 50 years.
Request for comment on the FY27 Community Preservation Act Plan.

SALEM HISTORICAL COMMISSION 
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 21, 2026 
6:00 P.M. 
 
*Notice is hereby given that a meeting of the Salem Historical Commission will be held on Wednesday, 0ctober 
21, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. via remote participation in accordance with Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2025. 
 
Every effort will be made to ensure that the public can adequately access the proceedings in real time, via 
technological means. If we are unable to do so on matters not requiring a public hearing, we will post on the 
City of Salem’s website an audio or video recording, transcript, or other comprehensive record of proceedings 
as soon as possible after the meeting. 
 
Individuals may participate remotely in the meeting via a remote participation platform called Zoom. 
Members of the public and/or parties with a right and/or requirement to attend this meeting may access the 
remote participation meeting through any one of the following ways: 
 
• Go to website https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84960311374?pwd=f5HgjSabX6VFbUXJTWFWkUHfa4vhpg.1 
or enter it into your web browser to join the meeting; or  
• Go to the website link https://zoom.us/join and enter Webinar ID# 849 6031  1374 and enter  
Passcode 175703 ; 
• Dial a toll-free phone number 877-853-5257 (Toll Free). When prompted, enter Webinar ID # 
849 6031 1374 , enter Passcode 175703  and follow the instructions to join the meeting. Those only 
dialing in will not have access to the direct video feed of the meeting but can follow along with the 
project materials that will be available for download online prior to the meeting; 
• The link to access project materials can be found at 10.21.26 SHC Meeting 
 
Members of the public attending this meeting virtually will be allowed to make comments if they wish to do 
so, during the portion of the hearing designated for public comment. The meeting will be opened early at 5:45 
pm to allow members of the public to test their audio. During portions of the meeting in which public 
comment is permitted, members of the public who have “raised their hand” in Zoom will be called on to offer 
comment. In order to raise a hand, members of the public using the Zoom computer or phone application may 
click the “Raise Hand” button; members of the public dialing in may press “*9” to raise their hand to speak.

1) 141 Federal Street – Steven Gregory and Mary Bratun – Certificate of Appropriateness – replace wood 
gutters – This application is being reviewed as a minor change under the Historical Commission policy for 
gutter replacement with approved gutter material. If no abutter objection is received, a certificate will be 
issued on October 16, 2026. 
 
2) 183R Federal Street – Alina McCurdy - Certificate of Appropriateness – architectural roof shingles - This 
application is being reviewed as a minor change under the Historical Commission policy for architectural 
roof shingles. If no abutter objection is received, a certificate will be issued on October 16, 2026. 
 
3) 1A Cambridge Street – Eleanor Uddo – Certificate of Appropriateness – install solar – continuation 
 
4) 169 Federal Street – Alicia and Brian Peters – Certificate of Appropriateness – fencing - continuation 
 
5) 44 Derby Street – Adam Liebowitz and Kate Lerner – Certificate of Appropriateness – install heat pump and 
exterior conduits after the fact - continuation 
 
6) 107 Federal Street - Susan Hacker – Certificate of Appropriateness – A/C condenser and exterior electrical 
work after the fact - continuation 
 
7) 396 Essex Street – Daniel Levitt – Certificate of Appropriateness – door modifications 
 
8) 56 Margin Street (including 54 Margin Street, 7 High Street, 20 Endicott Street, 24 Endicott Street) 
–  Harborlight Homes and Lifebridge - Waiver of the Demolition Delay - demolish 2 buildings older than 
50 years; partial demolition of 1 building older than 50 years 
 
9) Request for comment – FY27 Community Preservation Act Plan  
 
10) Other Business:  
a. Minutes;  
b. Violations;  
c. Correspondence
